tips: Prioritize Reels over all other formats, specifically focusing on Science/Tech and Business news which are driving 10x more engagement than average.
Use English for tech-related Reels (e.g., Windows, AI, Microsoft) and Urdu for high-energy Pakistan sports or local breaking news.
Avoid static 'Pic' and 'Breaking' text formats for international news; these topics (Americas, Middle East) are currently yielding zero views.
Focus on high-stakes political shifts in the USA and Europe (e.g., Trump, elections) with headlines that name specific influential figures.
Schedule all major posts between 14:00 UTC and 20:00 UTC to capitalize on peak audience activity; avoid the 04:00-09:00 UTC slump.
Frame tech news around 'innovation' or 'disruption' (e.g., AI on iPhone) to maintain the high viral coefficients seen in recent data.

news.summary: Reels sab se zyada views de rahi hain, khaas tor par Science, Tech aur USA politics par. Static pics aur breaking news posts ka result bohat kam hai, is liye video content par focus karein. Pakistan cricket aur business news Urdu mein achi chalti hain, lekin posting timing 14:00 se 20:00 UTC ke darmiyan rakhein. Americas aur Middle East ki boring news se parhez karein kyunke unka response zero hai.
